Aug 2026.rationale:
Cheap, Fast-Growing Bank on the Rise
DCB Bank was selected by our ML engine for its rare combination of strong market momentum, fast business growth, and an attractive price tag. The stock has surged ~39% over the past year, yet still trades at just 7.6x earnings and below its book value — a bargain for a bank growing this quickly. Profits hit a record high for the fourth quarter in a row, with earnings up ~36% year-over-year. Loans grew ~17% and deposits ~20%, while bad loans are actually improving. Analysts overwhelmingly back it (16 buys, 0 holds), with price targets pointing to 25-40%+ upside from current levels. Growth isn't slowing down either — management is targeting 18-20% expansion annually over the next two years.
